name: 用量账本
author: JSJ189
description: 记录 pi-web-ui 自己的每一次模型调用：按模型统计调用数、TTFT、延迟、输出速度、token 与真实成本，可查看逐条记录、按模型筛选并导出 CSV。数据只来自本机会话与运行事件，不上传任何内容。
descriptionEn: Records every model call made inside pi-web-ui: per-model request counts, TTFT, latency, throughput, tokens and real recorded cost, with a filterable record list and CSV export. Data comes only from local sessions and run events; nothing is uploaded.
